name: Hikari no Umi no Apeiria
source:
"I don't know where you are, I don't remember your face or name. I don't even know if you really exist. But I promise I will find you."
"This mail was sent from the future..."

Winter, year 2045. Kirishima Reiichi, who belongs to the AI research club, had finally succeed in developing an artificial intelligence called "Apeiria".

Using the functions of Apeiria, he made the technology called "VRMMO: the virtual world", which is a fusion of magic, science and all those things from the books. However, VRMMO was a dangerous game with no control. Unfortunately, Apeiria was captured in the virtual world.

Now the protagonist and his friends: his step sister Miu, a rude girl with no friends, his kouhai Mashiro, which wants to be his "slave" and Kuon, a girl with a kind personality, who had chuunibyou syndrome two years ago have to rescue Apeiria from the virtual world. This is story about love, youth and science.

[From [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=949419]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
“我不知道你在哪里，我不记得你的脸和名字。我什至不知道你是否真的存在。但我保证我会找到你。”
“这封邮件是从未来寄来的……”

2045年冬天，人工智能研究部成员雾岛丽一终于成功开发出一种名为“Apeiria”的人工智能。

利用Apeiria的功能，他创造了一种名为“VRMMO：虚拟世界”的技术，它融合了魔法、科学和所有书本上的东西。然而，VRMMO是一款危险且无法控制的游戏。不幸的是，阿佩里亚在虚拟世界中被捕获。

现在，主角和他的朋友们：他的继妹Miu，一个没有朋友的粗鲁女孩，他的kouhai Mashiro，想要成为他的“奴隶”，以及Kuon，一个性格善良的女孩，两年前患有中二病综合症，必须将Apeiria从虚拟世界中拯救出来。这是一个关于爱情、青春和科学的故事。

[来自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=949419]Getchu[/url]]
